description: Screenshot of a Google search 'Top stories' news carousel showing three headlines about a SpaceX Falcon 9 Block 5 launch attempt being called off at the last minute, from CNN Money, Space.com and GeekWire. Each card has a photo of the rocket on the pad or in transport. Filename 'F9' refers to Falcon 9; the Block 5 debut launch (Bangabandhu-1) was scrubbed May 10, 2018.
text: Top stories. SpaceX calls off launch of its new rocket at the last minute. CNN Money. 11 hours ago. SpaceX's New Falcon 9 Block 5 Rocket Debuts Today: How to Watch Live. Space.com. 18 hours ago. Computer aborts milestone SpaceX rocket launch at last minute, forcing a day's... GeekWire. 6 hours ago.
flags: Launch date/mission (Bangabandhu-1, May 2018) inferred from headlines and filename, not shown in image

The lower panel is an ad for Seth Wadley Ford of Pauls Valley, Oklahoma, on a Lindmark billboard structure.

description: Extreme close-up, slightly blurry photo of White House letterhead stationery: the gold presidential eagle seal and part of the printed words 'THE WHITE HOUSE' are visible, mostly covered by a dark textured object (a phone case or folder) with a black textured pen lying across it. Images like this were posted by Q as supposed proof of White House access.
flags: Setting is implied by the letterhead only; nothing verifies where or when the photo was taken

description: Screenshot of Q post No.979213 on 8chan, tripcode !xowAT4Z3VQ, dated 04/09/18 (Mon) 22:48:24, ID 466abe. The post header carries roughly 96 reply-links from other anons. The body quotes post >>979093 and gives the drop's five 'TRUST' lines naming Sessions, Wray, 'Kansas' (Mike Pompeo), Horowitz and Huber, signed Q.

description: Photograph of a vast outdoor parking area filled with thousands of scooters and motorbikes in front of large multi-story white industrial/factory buildings, with blue Chinese-language street signs, streetlights, hedges and metal barriers in the foreground under a hazy sky. The filename 'Foxconn_ZZ' indicates it is presented as the Foxconn manufacturing campus in Zhengzhou, China ('iPhone City').
flags: Identification as Foxconn Zhengzhou comes from the filename/post context; the Chinese street signs are consistent with China but the specific campus is not verifiable from the image alone

description: Night photograph of central London from an elevated position on the Victoria Embankment side of the Thames: the London Eye lit in blue at left, a moored riverboat, bare trees, and queued traffic with headlights along the embankment road, with the illuminated clock face of Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben) in the distance. The filename 'NSA_Traf_CAM_ROT1' presents it as an NSA traffic-camera capture; it accompanied Q's series of London photos in drop 1423.
flags: The filename's claim that this is an NSA traffic camera image is unverified; it appears to be an ordinary elevated night photo

text: TheLastRefuge. @TheLastRefuge2. Following. 1. Sometimes Conspiracy Theories are not theory. Nellie Ohr, is the wife of DOJ Deputy Bruce Ohr and she is an employee with Fusion GPS. Why would she apply for a Ham Radio License a month after Fusion GPS contracted with MI6 agent Christopher Steele? wireless2.fcc.gov/UlsApp/LicArch ... 7:36 PM - 11 Dec 2017.
flags: The tweet's insinuation about the ham radio license is the author's claim; the license application itself was real but the implied purpose is speculation

description: Two-column screenshot of Q post No.1497716, tripcode !CbboFOtcZs, 05/21/18 (Mon) 16:04:49, ID 622a94. The left column is the drop: a 'Military OP' statement invoking 'General K [JFK]', demands about Rod Rosenstein ([RR]) recusing or being terminated, Wray's reporting line, Mueller oversight, Sessions un-recusing, and Rachel Brand's departure. The right column quotes an explanation of the Vacancies Reform Act of 1998 and acting-official succession (naming Jesse Panuccio and Scott Pruitt), a justice.gov link, and closes with Schneiderman's removal, 'TRUST (name)', 'These people are stupid.', 'D5' and Q. Filename '321RR' tags the RR countdown theme.
text: Q !CbboFOtcZs 05/21/18 (Mon) 16:04:49 ID: 622a94 No.1497716 >>1497721 >>1497722 >>1497724. Military OP. [Green]. General K [JFK]. Full Disclosure. General Statement: Once the 'extremely guarded & highly classified' information is finally revealed to House investigators, DNI, public etc., RR must recuse or forcefully terminated. [RR] problems. What was RR's Senate Conf Vote? WRAY reports to RR [important fact]. Who do you TRUST? [RR] recuse/fired who has direct oversight of Mueller? Sessions un-recuse or #3 [until refill]? Who is Rachel Brand? Why was Rachel Brand dismissed? Think timing. "The succession question is actually a bit complicated. By default, under an obscure statute known as the the Vacancies Reform Act of 1998, Brand's temporary successor as the "acting" associate attorney general is her principal deputy, Jesse Panuccio. That same statute would also allow the president to choose someone else to serve as the "acting" AAG on a temporary basis for up to 210 days; the pool of individuals from which the president could draw in this case includes individuals already holding Senate-confirmed positions elsewhere in the executive branch (like EPA administrator Scott Pruitt) or senior civil service lawyers in the Justice Department, specifically." "Acting". https://www.justice.gov/asg. When does the clock run out? Why is Schneiderman's removal 'extremely' relevant? TRUST (name). These people are stupid. D5. Q
flags: 'General K [JFK]' is Q-drop shorthand; reading it as John F. Kelly is an interpretation. Small text transcribed best-effort; a few characters may be imperfect

description: Photo of a television screen showing Fox News live breaking coverage (via KABC) of the December 2, 2015 San Bernardino, CA shooting, timestamped 12:19 PM. A witness being interviewed wears sunglasses and a dark ball cap bearing the Masonic square-and-compasses emblem. Chyron reads that the shooter walked into a conference room and opened fire; the ticker fragment mentions someone 'who repeatedly asked for medical attention'. Shared in Q circles for the Freemason symbol on the witness's cap.
text: SAN BERNARDINO, CA. 12:19 PM. KABC. Age. FOX NEWS. FOX NEWS. LIVE. Breaking. REPORT: SHOOTER WALKED INTO CONF ROOM, OPENED FIRE. AY, WHO REPEATEDLY ASKED FOR MEDICAL ATTENTION. NAS 25.0
flags: The interviewed witness is a private individual and is not identified
Q-community framing attaches significance to the Masonic cap; the image itself shows only a bystander interview
